title: loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard dense visual prediction architectures scale representation capacity by stacking deep feedforward decoders (6-16 transformer layers with 50M-200M parameters). This explicit layer stacking brings substantial activation memory overhead during backpropagation, requires high off-chip memory bandwidth for non-tied weights, and uses static computational allocation that cannot adapt to spatial image complexity.   We propose loopxDINO, which replaces physical decoder depth with iterative latent reasoning. translated_title: loopxDINO：通过迭代潜在推理实现密集视觉预测
translated_abstract: 标准的密集视觉预测架构通过堆叠深层前馈解码器（6-16层transformer，参数量5000万至2亿）来扩展表示能力。这种显式的层堆叠在反向传播期间带来大量的激活内存开销，需要高片外内存带宽以支持非权重绑定的参数，并采用无法适应图像空间复杂度的静态计算分配方式。我们提出loopxDINO，用迭代潜在推理取代物理上的解码器深度。它包含两个解耦的组件：（1）一个冻结的DINOv2-Base骨干网络，通过单次前向传播提取空间特征，并将静态的Key-Value表示缓存至GPU内存；（2）一个紧凑的、权重绑定的循环交叉注意力解码器（核心参数仅7.96M，可训练参数总计14.85M），在T次迭代中循环更新查询向量。循环过程通过步数条件化的adaLN、基于LayerNorm的超椭球流形正则化（摘要在此处截断）加以稳定。
tldr: loopxDINO以冻结的DINOv2骨干网络配合紧凑的权重绑定循环交叉注意力解码器，用迭代潜在推理取代深层堆叠解码器，以不到15M的可训练参数实现高效的密集视觉预测，同时显著降低内存开销与计算冗余。
en_tdlr: loopxDINO replaces deep stacked decoders with iterative latent reasoning, using a frozen DINOv2 backbone and a compact weight-tied looped cross-attention decoder (under 15M trainable parameters) to achieve efficient dense visual prediction with greatly reduced memory overhead.
